previous_decisions.quote: This replication and extension of DeYoung, Quilty, Peterson and Gray’s (2014) study aimed to assess the unique variance of each of the 10 aspects of the Big Five personality traits (DeYoung, Quilty & Peterson, 2007) associated to intelligence and its dimensions. Personality aspects and intelligence were assessed in a sample of French-Canadian adults from real-life assessment settings (n = 213). Results showed that the Intellect aspect was independently associated to g, verbal and nonverbal intelligence while its counterpart Openness was independently related to verbal intelligence only, thus replicating the results of the original study.
